retell_custom_tools.name: identify_patient
retell_custom_tools.description: Collects caller full name and date of birth to look up chart at Md Primary Care INC. Note: This identifies the caller record but leaves identity unverified.

patient_name.description: Patient's full legal name as spoken by caller (e.g., 'Eleanor Vance')

date_of_birth.description: Patient's date of birth in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., '1985-04-12')

retell_custom_tools.name: get_patient_information
retell_custom_tools.description: Retrieves authorized clinic and provider details for an identified patient. Requires name and date of birth.

date_of_birth.description: Patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

patient_id.description: Optional patient chart ID if previously identified

retell_custom_tools.name: check_appointment_availability
retell_custom_tools.description: Queries sample available appointment time slots for Dr. Chintan Shah at Md Primary Care INC. Rejects past dates.

date_of_birth.description: Patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

requested_date.description: Requested appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (must be today or in the future)

retell_custom_tools.name: book_appointment
retell_custom_tools.description: Books a simulated appointment slot with Dr. Chintan Shah. Validates slot existence and prevents duplicate bookings.

date_of_birth.description: Patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

appointment_time.description: Selected slot time in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g., '09:00', '11:00', or '14:30')

retell_custom_tools.name: reschedule_appointment
retell_custom_tools.description: Reschedules an existing confirmed appointment at Md Primary Care INC. to a new date and time.

date_of_birth.description: Patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

appointment_reference.description: Booking reference code (e.g. BK-DEMO-...) if provided

new_date.description: New target date in YYYY-MM-DD format

new_time.description: New target slot time in 24-hour HH:MM format (e.g. 09:00, 11:00, 14:30)

retell_custom_tools.name: cancel_appointment
retell_custom_tools.description: Cancels an existing appointment at Md Primary Care INC. and releases the reserved slot.

date_of_birth.description: Patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

retell_custom_tools.name: request_medication_refill
retell_custom_tools.description: Submits a simulated prescription refill request for clinical staff review at Md Primary Care INC.

date_of_birth.description: Patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

medication_name.description: Name and dosage of the requested medication (e.g., 'Lisinopril 10mg')

preferred_pharmacy_name.description: Pharmacy chain or name (e.g., 'Walgreens' or 'CVS Pharmacy')

pharmacy_location.description: Pharmacy street address, cross street, or city

retell_custom_tools.name: answer_clinic_question
retell_custom_tools.description: Queries approved clinic knowledge for Md Primary Care INC. on hours, location, accepted insurance, doctors, and visit preparation.

question.description: The caller's general question regarding clinic policies or details

retell_custom_tools.name: take_message
retell_custom_tools.description: Records a message from the caller to be delivered to Md Primary Care INC. doctors or clinical staff.
